name: National Museum of Cambodia
scope: The standing National Museum of Cambodia at Street 13 in Phnom Penh. Includes Groslier’s front block, temple-roof pavilions, flanking extensions and the galleries enclosing the central court.
era: Standing museum with its 1924 front wings.

originalReview.notes: Five columned forward projections, a raised cluster with narrow spires and gable tips, successive lower tile roofs, and a raked frontal perspective showing the building after the 1924 additions.

review.method: Qualla media checked first, then a date-verified original 1930 printed photograph.
review.notes: Started with the exact Qualla CC0 moon-rock photograph and excluded it as unrelated to the exterior. The supplemental photograph comes from the inspected 1930 EFEO imprint and retains the source line, caption and institutional scan identification.
